title: Pan-Seared Tuna with Tunisian Salad
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring pan-seared tuna, topped with a refreshing Tunisian salad.

ingredients.name: tunisian salad mix
ingredients.notes: Pre-mixed salad with olives, capers, garlic, and lemon

instructions: 2. Season the tuna steaks with salt and pepper.
3. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the tuna steaks for 2 minutes on each side.
5. Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the tuna reaches 120°F (49°C) for medium-rare.
6. While the tuna cooks, mix the tunisian salad mix, chopped tarragon, and a squeeze of lemon juice in a bowl.
7. Once the tuna is done, let it rest for 2 minutes before slicing it thinly.
8. Serve the sliced tuna on top of the tunisian salad.
9. Garnish with additional tarragon leaves and lemon wedges, if desired.
